remarks: GREAT OPPORTUNITY IN THE HEART OF NORWALK!  Charming ranch-style townhouse located in a highly desirable area of South Norwalk. This home offers convenient access to a variety of amenities including restaurants, shopping, beaches, boating, parks, SoNo Collection Mall, Metro-North stations, and major highways (I-95 N-S, Routes 1 & 7, and Merritt Parkway). Whether you work in NYC or commute to nearby towns, this location is ideal.  The townhouse features two levels of comfortable living space with a traditional floor plan. The main level includes a spacious living room, dining room, and kitchen. Upstairs you'll find one bedroom, a full bathroom, and a laundry room for added convenience. The exterior of the complex has been completely remodeled, enhancing curb appeal and overall community aesthetics.  Sale is subject to probate court approval. * House to be sold in "as-is" condition - No exceptions 1 assigned parking spot + 1 visitor parking spot Don't miss your chance to live in the heart of it all - schedule your tour today!
